limitations: Measured on the host GPU only (latency_source=measured, device host-gpu-0). Engines are device-specific and are not evidence for Jetson or any other target; those targets are BLOCKED.
Batch 1, static input shape; fps_batch1 = 1000/p50 is a batch-1 rate, not a throughput measurement.
pytorch:FP16 is autocast over FP32 weights; tensorrt:FP16 is a TensorRT FP16-flag engine (TF32 flag recorded).
Accuracy deltas compare runtimes of the same weights on one split with the common evaluator; absolute AP is not a model-quality claim.
raw_output_max_abs_diff_vs_reference is a diagnostic only: for top-k heads (RT-DETR, YOLO26 end2end) query order and the class-index column can differ between runtimes.

Accuracy deltas use the evaluator operating point (conf floor 0.001, max_det 300); latency uses postprocess_operating_point.latency only where postprocess_operating_point.latency.applied_by_adapter is true.
